Vegeriai Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Šiauliai County, Lithuania

Not demolished. Vegeriai's brick synagogue, built in 1890, was closed in July 1941 and demolished after the war, its site later used for agriculture; archaeological excavations in 2017 uncovered the remains of the synagogue, a mikvah, and a school. On the eve of the German invasion, only 50 Jews remained in Vegeriai. Armed Lithuanian nationalists transferred the entire community to Akmene, and on August 5, 1941, the Jews of both towns were taken to Mazeikiai — the massive regional massacre site documented at length elsewhere in this collection — and shot, buried in mass graves nearby.
